calibre_m.note: Published bore diameter (30x173 mm PGU-13/B HEI & PGU-14/B API)

rate_of_fire_rpm.note: Published cyclic firing rate per gun mount (30x173 mm PGU-13/B HEI & PGU-14/B API)

muzzle_velocity_ms.note: Published nominal muzzle velocity (30x173 mm PGU-13/B HEI & PGU-14/B API)

projectile_kg.note: Published projectile mass (30x173 mm PGU-13/B HEI & PGU-14/B API)

shed_mass_kg.note: Closed-loop linkless GAU-8/A drum retains spent cases; shed mass = projectile (~0.36 kg) + propellant gas (~0.135 kg)

explosive_kg.note: Nominal HEI/SAPHEI explosive filler mass per round (30x173 mm PGU-13/B HEI & PGU-14/B API); varies by ammunition mix

dispersion_rad.note: 1-sigma angular dispersion (derived class value from typical 5-8 mil 80% airborne cannon dispersion circle)

drag_cd.note: Reference supersonic form-scaled Cd at Mach 1.8 against BRL/McCoy G7 boattail standard curve (Cd_G7(1.8)=0.298)

elevation_rad.note: Published fixed gun mount depression angle relative to fuselage waterline

self_destruct_s.note: Pyrotechnic self-destruct fuze / effective max flight time for 30x173 mm PGU-13/B HEI & PGU-14/B API (varies by fuze lot)

stanag-4355.title: NATO STANAG 4355 (Modified Point Mass Trajectory Model) & R. L. McCoy, Modern Exterior Ballistics (Schiffer, 1999)
